api/src/services/app_bundler/__init__.py.name: App builder
api/src/services/app_bundler/__init__.py.description: Turns an app's source files into a ready-to-run bundle and reports any build errors in plain language.

api/src/services/app_bundler/auto_migrat.name: Automatic source updates
api/src/services/app_bundler/auto_migrat.description: Rewrites older app source files into the current style before a build so they keep working.

api/src/services/app_bundler/bundle.js.name: Bundle script
api/src/services/app_bundler/bundle.js.description: Packs an app's source files and its dependencies into one runnable file the browser can load.

api/src/services/app_bundler/package.jso.name: Builder dependencies
api/src/services/app_bundler/package.jso.description: Lists the build tools the app builder needs so the build environment can install them.

api/src/services/app_compiler/__init__.p.name: App code compiler
api/src/services/app_compiler/__init__.p.description: Converts app source into code browsers can run and generates the styling, so apps preview and load.

api/src/services/app_compiler/compile.js.name: Compile script
api/src/services/app_compiler/compile.js.description: Translates one app source file into plain browser code that previews and live apps can run.

api/src/services/app_compiler/package.js.name: Compiler dependencies
api/src/services/app_compiler/package.js.description: Lists the translation tools the app compiler needs so the build environment can install them.

api/src/services/app_compiler/tailwind.j.name: Style sheet builder
api/src/services/app_compiler/tailwind.j.description: Scans an app's screens for the styles they use and writes the matching style sheet.

api/src/services/app_dependencies.py.name: App workflow links
api/src/services/app_dependencies.py.description: Reads an app's source to find which workflows it relies on, so the platform knows what an app needs.

api/src/services/app_storage.py.name: Built app storage
api/src/services/app_storage.py.description: Keeps each app's built files in cloud storage and serves the right version to whoever opens it.

api/src/services/application_build.py.name: App rebuild and release
api/src/services/application_build.py.description: Rebuilds an app from its saved source, uploads the result and switches people over to the new version.

api/src/services/application_deploy_stor.name: Deploy upload staging
api/src/services/application_deploy_stor.description: Holds an uploaded app source file just long enough for one deploy, then discards it.

api/src/services/application_sdk_status..name: App toolkit version status
api/src/services/application_sdk_status..description: Says whether an app uses the current app toolkit and whether it needs a routine or a breaking update.

api/src/services/application_source_arch.name: Source archive checks
api/src/services/application_source_arch.description: Checks an uploaded app source archive is safe and complete, and strips anything that should not be kept.

api/src/services/application_source_arti.name: Saved app source copies
api/src/services/application_source_arti.description: Keeps a clean read-only copy of each app release's source so the app can be rebuilt without a full reinstall.

api/src/services/application_source_reso.name: App source lookup
api/src/services/application_source_reso.description: Finds the saved source for one app so it can be rebuilt or updated on its own.

api/src/services/editor/file_filter.py.name: Hidden file rules
api/src/services/editor/file_filter.py.description: Decides which files the editor and search skip, such as caches, build output and hidden system files.

api/src/services/package_generation.py.name: Package change log
api/src/services/package_generation.py.description: Records each change to the extra Python packages a workspace needs so every server applies them in order.

api/src/services/package_manager.py.name: Package installer
api/src/services/package_manager.py.description: Finds and installs extra Python packages a workspace needs, and reports their versions and any failures.

api/src/services/repo_sync_writer.py.name: Workspace inventory writer
api/src/services/repo_sync_writer.py.description: Rewrites the saved inventory of workspace apps, agents and workflows after something changes.

api/src/services/sdk_generator.py.name: Integration code generator
api/src/services/sdk_generator.py.description: Writes ready-to-use Python code for talking to another service, using sign-in details already saved in Bifrost.

api/src/services/sdk_package/__init__.py.name: App toolkit release
api/src/services/sdk_package/__init__.py.description: Builds and versions the helper code apps use to talk to Bifrost, and serves the current copy to browsers.

api/src/services/sdk_package/build_sdk.j.name: Toolkit build script
api/src/services/sdk_package/build_sdk.j.description: Produces either the small installed copy of the app toolkit or the full copy browsers load from the server.

api/src/services/sdk_package/build_types.name: Editor hints for app code
api/src/services/sdk_package/build_types.description: Writes the companion description file that lets code editors suggest and check Bifrost calls in app code.

api/src/services/sdk_package/package.jso.name: Toolkit package settings
api/src/services/sdk_package/package.jso.description: Names and versions the toolkit package that apps install so every release can be identified.

api/src/services/sdk_package/tsconfig.ty.name: Toolkit type settings
api/src/services/sdk_package/tsconfig.ty.description: Sets how the toolkit's companion description file is generated for code editors.

api/src/services/sdk_reference_scanner.p.name: Missing setting checker
api/src/services/sdk_reference_scanner.p.description: Checks workflows for the settings and integrations they use and flags any that do not exist yet.

api/src/services/templates/sdk.py.j2.name: Generated code template
api/src/services/templates/sdk.py.j2.description: The fill-in-the-blanks layout used when writing ready-to-use Python code for another service.
